```lean
theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : n + 1 ≤ 2 ^ n := by
  induction n with d hd
  case zero => contradiction
  case succ d =>
    have h1 : d + 1 ≤ 2 ^ d := hd
    have h2 : 2 * (2 ^ d) = 2 ^ (d + 1) := by rw [pow_add, mul_two]
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact le_trans h1 (le_add_right 1 (2 ^ d))
```
